privacy_desc: Sonar is a student project built for the Transcendence curriculum at 42 School. This page explains what data we collect, why, and how you stay in control of it
privacy_data_desc: We collect only what the game needs to run:
privacy_data_acc_desc: Username, email address, avatar, and the OAuth identifier from your Google or Discord account if you sign in with one
privacy_data_sec_desc: Hashed password, two-factor secret, sign-in timestamps
privacy_data_game_desc: Match history, score, shot accuracy, forfeits
privacy_data_soc_desc: Friend list, invitations, duo chat messages, blocked users
privacy_data_tec_desc: IP address and server logs, kept for security and debugging
privacy_need_desc: Solely to authenticate you, run matches and the leaderboard, show your profile to other players, moderate abusive behaviour, and protect scores when someone disconnects. No data is ever sold, rented, or used for advertising. No third-party trackers are embedded
privacy_others_desc: Your username, avatar, score, statistics, and match history are visible to other players (profile, leaderboard). Your email address and private messages never are
privacy_cookies_desc: A single session cookie (your authentication token) keeps you signed in. It is strictly necessary to the service and expires when you log out or after a period of inactivity. No advertising or analytics cookies are used
privacy_ret_desc: Account data is kept for as long as the account exists. Technical logs are rotated automatically and are not kept indefinitely. When you delete your account everything is erased; only past match results are retained in anonymised form so historical standings stay intact
privacy_rights_desc: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct, erase, and port your data, and to object to its processing. Most of these actions are available directly in your account settings
privacy_contact_desc: all traffic is encrypted (HTTPS/WSS), passwords are hashed, and two-factor authentication is available on every account. For any question or request about your data:
terms_desc: By creating an account or joining a match you accept the rules below. They cover use of the service, fair play, and moderation
terms_service_desc: Sonar is an online naval combat game built by 42 School students as part of the Transcendence project. It is provided free of charge, as is, with no guarantee of availability: it may be interrupted, reset, or shut down at any time, in particular once the project has been evaluated
terms_acc_desc: One account per person. You are responsible for your credentials and for everything done through your account; enabling two-factor authentication is strongly recommended. Usernames and avatars that are offensive, impersonate someone else, or infringe trademarks will be changed or removed
terms_fair_desc: The following are prohibited and punished by point loss, suspension or a ban:
terms_fair_1: Using bots, scripts, or modified clients to reveal an opponent's grid
terms_fair_2: Colluding with other players or fixing matches, and sharing information outside the duo chat provided for that purpose
terms_fair_3: Running multiple accounts to inflate a score
terms_fair_4: Any attempt to attack the server, other players, or the integrity of the leaderboard
terms_leaving_desc: Leaving a ranked match in progress counts as a loss and costs you points. In 3- and 4-player games a bot takes over the departing player's fleet so the match stays playable for everyone else, and the remaining players' scores are protected
terms_leaving_warn: Repeated forfeits and deliberate early disconnects can lead to a temporary ban from ranked matchmaking
terms_chat_desc: Duo chat is there for teammates to coordinate. Hateful, harassing, discriminatory, or illegal messages are forbidden. You can block a player any time from their profile or the conversation
terms_rank_desc: Points go up and down with your results. Matches against a bot are unranked. We reserve the right to cancel a match or correct a score in the event of a confirmed bug or cheating
terms_content_desc: Sonar's code and artwork remain the property of their authors. You keep ownership of everything you post (username, avatar, messages) and grant us the right to display it in the game so the service can work
terms_contact_desc: You can delete your account at any time from your settings. We may suspend an account that breaches these terms. French law applies. Any question?
